activation_rule.estimator: direct linear-probability intercept with centered left/right covariate; CR1 voter-cluster robust SE
activation_rule.log_loss: preregistered secondary only; not used for B6 activation sizing
activation_rule.multiplicity: Holm across all six eligible topologies

conditional: same OC targets but 1441-2880 total ballots

design.left_right: within each voter x topology: exactly two V9-left and two V9-right ballots

generator_audit.planning_source: candidate-blind pre-vote V8 development catalog is used only as a player/FV source pool; no V8 outcomes or candidate scores are read

nuisance_assurance: sample the exact 500 B5C crossed-bootstrap nuisance draws; B5A nuisance estimates are separately guarded. This avoids simultaneous p90+p90 stress as the only sizing basis.

primary_scenarios.one_harmful_0p49: rotate one theta=0.49 through all six positions; remaining theta=0.60
primary_scenarios.two_harmful_0p49: cycle pairs of theta=0.49; remaining theta=0.60

purpose: Determine whether topology-specific activation on fresh discordant challenges can restore a feasible V9 validation design without lowering the 5% familywise harmful-activation standard.
stop: no design <=2880 ballots clears the OC targets
